scenarios.title: Register attendee without manual ID auto-assigns ID and returns QR data
given: identity generation succeeds and assigns a new attendee ID (e.g. 1001)
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent to the event path without an ID (e.g. GET /new/TechConf)
then: a successful JSON response is returned containing id, url, imgsrc, and data
the response id matches the assigned attendee ID (e.g. 1001)
the response url is formatted with the request host and attendee ID (e.g. 'https://example.com/1001')
the response imgsrc is formatted with the lowercased event name and attendee ID (e.g. 'https://example.com/techconf/1001.png')
the response data contains the base64 QR code data URL

scenarios.title: Register attendee with manual numeric ID preserves ID and returns QR data
given: a manually supplied numeric ID in the URL (e.g. 2048)
identity generation succeeds for the specified attendee ID
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent with the numeric ID (e.g. GET /new/TechConf/2048)
then: a successful JSON response is returned containing id, url, imgsrc, and data
the response id matches the manual attendee ID (e.g. 2048)
the response url is formatted with the request host and manual attendee ID (e.g. 'https://example.com/2048')
the response imgsrc is formatted with the lowercased event name and manual attendee ID (e.g. 'https://example.com/techconf/2048.png')
the response data contains the base64 QR code data URL

scenarios.title: Registration fails with unauthorized error when database returns falsy identity
given: an event registration request where the identity lookup or underlying query returns no recordset
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent (e.g. GET /new/TechConf or GET /new/TechConf/999)
then: an unauthorized HTML error response is returned
the error page displays the message 'Invalid ID.'
no JSON response body is returned

scenarios.title: Registration fails with server error when QR image file generation fails
given: an event name and successful attendee identity assignment
QR PNG image file generation encounters an error
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent (e.g. GET /new/TechConf)
then: a server error HTML response is returned
the error page displays the message 'Couldn't create .png file.'
no JSON response body is returned

scenarios.title: Registration fails with server error when QR data URL generation fails
given: an event name and successful attendee identity assignment
QR PNG image file generation succeeds but QR data URL generation encounters an error
scenarios.when: an attendee registration request is sent (e.g. GET /new/TechConf)
then: a server error HTML response is returned
the error page displays the message 'Couldn't create the data blob.'
no JSON response body is returned

scenarios.title: Registration request with non-numeric second segment results in not found
given: an event name and a non-numeric second URL segment (e.g. GET /new/TechConf/vip)
scenarios.when: a request is sent to the non-numeric path
then: a not found response is returned
the request is not processed by the registration handler
